//: Every app route is now prerendered to its own static HTML file by
scripts/prerender.js, so the old catch-all rewrite to /index.html is gone.
It had to go: with that rewrite in place, any unknown URL was served the
homepage's HTML — including the homepage's canonical tag — with a 200.
Vercel matches the filesystem first and then falls back to dist/404.html
with a real 404 status, which the prerenderer now emits.
Consequence worth knowing: a route that exists in App.jsx but NOT in
src/seo/meta.js will not be prerendered, and will hard-404 on a direct load
instead of silently working. Add new routes to meta.js.

redirects.//: /contact is a client-side <Navigate> in App.jsx. Without a server-side redirect it would 404 on a direct load or an inbound link.
